question: We want to calculate a financial metric. Please help us compute it by basing your answers off of the statement of income and the statement of cash flows. * **Amortization of Content Assets:** $3,405,382 thousand *(Note: The cash flow statement shows amortization of content assets of $3,405,382 thousand)*

$$\text{Unadjusted EBITDA} = \text{Operating Income} + \text{Depreciation and Amortization (Property, Equipment, and Intangibles)} + \text{Amortization of Content Assets}$$

$$\text{Unadjusted EBITDA} = \$305,826 + \$62,283 + \$3,405,382 = \$3,773,491 \text{ thousand}$$

* **Excluding Content Amortization (Standard PPE/Intangibles D&A only):**
  $$\text{EBITDA Margin} = \frac{\$368,109}{\$6,779,511} \times 100\% \approx \mathbf{5.43\%}$$
